nummer.over: Over de kriebels en zenuwen van een eerste ontmoeting, zoals op je eerste schooldag. Debuutnummer van boygroup TWS; het werd een van de grootste hits van 2024 in Korea.

quotes: Je hoeft niet perfect te zijn om te schitteren. Gewoon jezelf is al genoeg licht.
I want to hear your voice, and I want to hear your conviction.
We have learned to love ourselves, so now I urge you to 'speak yourself.'
I have also learned that I should try to love myself a bit more.
We're grateful that we are still doing shows and people come to see us and we're proud to have come this far.
I'm always trying really hard to show the best version of myself when I'm performing.
We're a group, so that's how we work. Together.
I think I'll keep exploring different sides of myself rather than trying to fit into one label.
I have learnt that I am nothing without the Kids.
I never really thought that I was good at singing or rap or dancing. It's something that I practiced.
I thank a lot of people, not only around me, but also fans globally for helping me learn to love myself.
We're determined to challenge ourselves and push boundaries.
I wanted people to see me exactly as I am.
I still feel nervous, shaky, hopeful, and excited for the stage.
Seeing how people connect with my music in their own way made everything feel worth it.
I think that in order to not fall behind, I have to keep working hard.
I hope this song reminds people that it's okay to keep going at their own pace.
The fact that all five members are always together to this day seems like a miracle to me.
But them showing me love teaches me that I can be more confident in myself.
To me, it's about believing in yourself and continuing to move forward.
